steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Damn it, Amiya!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah...! What happened, Amiya?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Come here, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What I'm about to do next, you are not to tell anyone, ever.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en of Lungmen!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No longer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then I'll ask you to keep an eye on the dragon over there for me. We'll be taking her into custody when this is all over. Any questions?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Look after Amiya first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes. Doctor, give me your hand.

options: You'd just grab it anyway if I tried to back away, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: *Sigh*. This isn't going to hurt. But, don't ask.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm going to jam this syringe into your arm and take some blood. And that's all I'm telling you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's for your own good.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No questions.
She's right, it doesn't hurt. You don't feel anything.
Kal'tsit places your freshly drawn blood into a device on her waist. Seconds later, she administers a blue solution into Amiya's neck.
Amiya's breathing stabilizes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It worked. Amiya... wake up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh... Miss... Miss Theresa...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...No. It's me, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit... I...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're okay, Amiya. You don't have to talk. Let's get ready to go. It's all okay now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *whine*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wah... Aahh.... Waaahhh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Waaahhh... Doctor... Waaaaahh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um... Mm...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...My tears... Doctor, I managed not to cry until the end... I... I promised... I... I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor... Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ch'en, the aircraft will reach the control tower momentarily. We'll take Talulah and go.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you sure? I haven't... even decided how to handle her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We need Talulah. Rhodes Island must take her first.

options: The crazy shit you say doesn't even surprise me anymore.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you worried we're going to get ourselves killed?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No need, Dr. {@nickname}, that ship has long since sailed. It sailed as soon as we got involved here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have two swords hanging over our heads: one is Lungmen's and one belongs to the Third Army of Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We stopped the core city, we got involved in the attack on Lungmen, and we know the entire conspiracy. That's enough to have them plotting to destroy us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What would the Third Army do if Lungmen decided to strike at us?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They'd grab the popcorn.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The murderers in their fancy uniforms would watch our landship burn into a scorched hulk in the wastelands, one of the thorns in their side melting away.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And on the other side, a private company without registration in Lungmen, not under the protection of Lungmen, finds itself attacked and destroyed by unknown forces.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That doesn't sound like a problem for Lungmen or Yan, does it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Unless, of course, we're holding Talulah.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Anyone who might want to strike at us first needs to consider the signal they're sending. Does it say to their rivals that they need Talulah? That she's key to this case?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That she grants an advantage, that she could eliminate a weakness?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That is our one and only chance at survival.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is to Rhodes Island's great advantage that the magnates of Lungmen and the ancient nobility of Ursus will not find common ground in the next century.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If we hold Talulah, their hands are tied. Neither will want to make the first move.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Neither will want to risk the evidence vital to both sides. Their best course of action will be to remain at a safe distance. Both parties want to distance themselves from this smoking gun.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would take only one slight misstep to bring ruin to either the Third Army or Lungmen. Neither has the authority to stand for their entire country.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Third Army tried, once. And they will pay a terrible price for the mistake. The stakes are too high.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So we will seize the advantage in this situation. We will use each side to protect ourselves from the other.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Talulah is vital to our survival. At least for now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Those clever enough to survive will find a balancing point, and with Talulah in our hands, Rhodes Island can actively choose to be that very point.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At least until this all blows over, or they're swept up in the next storm.

options: I won't be able to convince you.
You planned this from the start, didn't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's the aircraft. Time to go. Get Talulah and Amiya in first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll take the next one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: There's no point in fighting any more. The guerrillas are gonna kill us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Fall back! Abandon the city! We lost! It's over.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Says who?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You're alive...

steps.name: W
steps.text: If I went down that easy, I couldn't ask you to come with me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Why? Why should we follow you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah. Need me to spell it out for you? You're free, ya goof.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: ...Huh? Free? What are you talking about?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You don't have to kill for anybody anymore. And it's not like I'm your boss now either, I'm just saying you can tag along with me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're done being hired muscle. Now you fight for yourselves! Oh, but still, you can't just be killing for fun. I'll blow your ribcage open if you do.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What I'm getting at is we don't have to listen to the bitches who just want our blades and bows. The ones who don't care if we die, as long as we take a bunch of lives with us.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But me? I'm built different. I appreciate money, and they gave us lots.

steps.name: W
steps.text: The thing is, we're still alive, and we can get more of it. Don't need to go piling up cash on gravestones.

steps.name: W
steps.text: See some haters? Kill 'em. Kill anybody who looks at us the wrong way. Kill anybody who wants to hurt us. Just wipe 'em all out.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not for Reunion, not for all the devils, not for anybody.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We make our own way in the world. Maybe we wanna go to Yan and learn how to play Go. Doesn't matter. It's all good.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You in?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Not like there's anywhere else to go.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We'll follow you. But no tricks, W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sorry, man. All I got is tricks.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Is it over?

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Looks good. I'm really glad we didn't have to pretend to be anyone's friend in order to kill them.

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: I never thought the plan would flip around to helping Reunion like this...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Thanks, bro! Nice work! Let's get out of here!

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Ursine) Don't mention it!

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Now we're their accomplices.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hawk, how about a coffee when we get back? I'll tell you about that op back in Columbia...

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: I was on your team.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Don't you remember your squadmates?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well you were never there for any of the missions.

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Well then... We might've really done some good this time.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Just a minute, kitten. Is that your aircraft? What's it doing?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Oh, I know...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It must be here to take Talulah. Ah, there it goes... we already have her.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What? You took Talulah?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: No, we can't allow that! Rhodes doesn't have the right!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: She must stand trial! She can't just walk away!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Sorry... this is how it is.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You want revenge, but you can't have it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: We can't put her on trial.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But you're taking her from us. You stole our chance to execute her!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Kitten, don't be so quick to show off what you've learned...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Hatred runs in our veins. The hatred of Reunion and all the Infected brothers Talulah killed fills us with the rage that gives us the right to try her.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Only us. No one else.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Will you give her a fair trial?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We are justice. Talulah can't escape us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Okay then, Mister. I'll make you a promise. We won't hand Talulah over to anyone but you and Reunion.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What are you going to do with her?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Even I don't know. But I can make you that promise.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Because I know we're doing what's right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Kill me now if you have to. I believe in Rhodes Island. I'll stand in for her.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What are you talking about?! Don't talk like that.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Look, kitten, if you think there's any difference between your loyalty and ours, you've got another thing coming. I Trust you. You'll be a glorious fighter someday.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Go on! For you, I'll trust Rhodes Island, just this once.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But you remember. I don't care if it's Talulah or the Lord of Fiends... if I hear you've stepped out of line even just once...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If I hear you've done harm to the downtrodden people of this world, we will hunt you down, we will strike you, and we will kill you all.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Especially Talulah. Don't use her for evil.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We'll spike their heads on the highest point in the city, to honor the Captain, our great warrior, who died here alone.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: This isn't how his story was supposed to end.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It won't come to that. Rhodes Island wouldn't do that. Even if they tried, I wouldn't let them.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Someday... I'll be just like you said. I'll be able to pick out who's good and who's bad.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No one should suffer the loss of a loved one. I'll do what's right. I'll be the judge.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I think I almost have my own standard.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We believe in you. We believe your promise, kitten! Young as you are, you're a lot stronger than so many spineless grown-ups.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Alright, we'll hold off on destroying Rhodes Island for now. Because you're there.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Pinky swear?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Huh? Haha, okay. Pinky swear.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If I had a daughter, she'd be about your age.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Kitten, the other girl, the Lord of Fiends... the Cautus. If she can really keep doing good...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You can count on us. If you ever get into trouble, we'll be there. Because the Captain... the Captain and Yelena... they chose her..

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I hope you'll prove right. I hope we're wrong.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But that's not how it'll go. Because we're doing the right thing.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Time to go.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Rosmontis! Thank you, Reunion fighters.... We have to go.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We're not Reunion anymore.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Goodbye, kitten. Hurry on home.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Bye bye, Mister.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Bye!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: They're gone, brothers.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But we can't. We have unfinished business.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Nothing from the leader of Reunion.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Chernobog's core city has stopped moving. Tell the Sixth, Seventh, and Twelfth Divisions, if they still want to proceed, we'll need...
Stop.
Or we will be forced to stop you.
Not that we would be able to, even if we tried.
Only you can put a stop to your nonsensical war machine in time.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: You cannot resist the blade of Ursus. Not this time.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: And you, the pawns of an incapable lord, who are you to give orders to us?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: (Gaulish) And how do you know you are not under the spell of Kashchey?

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Never speak that language to me again! The age of Gaul is over!

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Never again will that language be used to communicate between countries! Not a city of theirs remains!

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Kashchey is determined, a determined champion of Ursus!

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: You cut down the last man so praised by the people of Ursus.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: You need not be so overly prudent. We can offer you assistance. There are things only you may do.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: You would ask us to betray our country?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Young one... As I see it, you commit treason in proceeding with this plan of yours. What happens next is up to you, but it is Ursus who will suffer the consequences.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Having done all this, you must know: the nobles started this war to solve a problem, but war is far, far worse than the problem.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Where is it you will find ultimate peace in Ursus?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: You put an end to that era by your own hands. You know it better than we.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Wei Yenwu's minions. How did you find us?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: By our own effort. You have a lot to learn.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Are you threatening me?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: No. Only... we have aged.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: And while you boast of loyalty to your homeland...

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: There are some matters, however loyal you may view them... in which we will play no part.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: That which we will not do.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: (Gaulish) Let's take a step back, young one.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: The Royal Guard has fresh blood. You have more life ahead of you than we. If this is wrong, you will have time to right it.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: But you must think of Ursus, so as to avoid the same pitfalls.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Who will right it?

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: We will. You put a stop to your people.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: And you, old men... You're not in the Imperial Guard anymore. Don't interfere.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: Indeed, it has been a long, long time since we last were. Such is why we may speak freely. Long life to you, young one.

steps.name: Shadow Guard
steps.text: There will not be a next time.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Please... I'm begging you!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If you're going to kill me, just do it!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Just don't let them find me! They'll torture us... they always...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Enough gossip.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Move out! Come on, we don't want...

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The Shieldguards to get you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Are you... you really letting us go?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The captain would want you to live. Confusing one, that.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You stay away from them. Talulah's guards and the Shieldguards.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Confusing one.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You sure you want to stay?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: But Reunion is gone...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I think you can't even call the Shieldguards Reunion anymore.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: They sure don't call themselves that.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Unless... unless we were going to make some changes.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If we're Reunion, we have to change ourselves.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You still believe that?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I know we Infected can pull ourselves up when we fall.
Over the next thirty-six hours, the soldiers from Ursus's Third Army who had infiltrated the Chernobog core city quietly vanished.
Of course, no one could prove they were Ursus soldiers.
Before leaving the core city, the Shieldguards found Reunion corpses with no identifying items, except for the wounds in their flesh...
They were all caused by the same thrown weapon.
The formless killers planned to kill the heavies they knew, sending a quiet warning to the unseen parties who were not present.
Of course, the Shieldguards were more direct with their message. Traitors drown in their own blood.
A joint investigation team from Yan and Ursus submitted their reports two weeks after arriving in Chernobog.
They were clear: there was zero evidence that either of the two countries had anything to do with the tragedy.
They determined that the Chernobog Incident was created and caused by the Infected.

But the vagaries of political conflict meant that any further legal action to be taken against the Infected that might have been circulating in the major cities ultimately died in various legislatures, piles of unpassable bills...
Until finally meeting an unceremonious end in the old secretary's crank shredder during a cleanup.
Thus, the Chernobog Incident silently drew to a close.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm not a killer. Go this way. You can't stay here! If the Ursus Army finds you, they won't care if you're Infected or not. They're wiping out the city.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: So you're the only one we can trust?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If you want to live... you'll live.

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: We'll live. Where should we go?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Alright. Sure. This way.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I can't do anything about you hating us. But I hope we won't have any more hate for you, since you also lost your homes.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Brothers! Here. Take them. They're not Infected, so be careful.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Crownslayer? What about you?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Where are you going...? What should we do?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Why are you still following me?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're a leader of Reunion...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm nothing.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I want to go back to Siracusa.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why? Why would you...?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm weak. I need to get stronger.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Back when I was leaving Siracusa to go to Ursus, to take revenge for my father, my teacher stopped me. Saying I was weak, and I couldn't do it.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I didn't believe it. But it was the truth.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: My brain doesn't work like Talulah's. I'm not as skilled as my teacher. I'm weak.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Even the cause I believed in... was just somebody's tool. You all know, right? Talulah betrayed us. No matter what the deal is, Reunion is over.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I don't think this is how the movement ends.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Aren't you from Lungmen?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Yes. But where I come from doesn't matter to what I'm saying.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Whether or not she acknowledges it, and you have to realize it... No matter what happens to Reunion, Talulah already lit the flame.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: And you can't just put it out like this.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Sure. If that's how it is, I think they're better off going with you.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Are you asking that of me?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Let's say I'm entrusting them to you. You might be lying to me here, but these people lost their homes. I won't lie to you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: They'll be worse off with me.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Okay, are you willing to come with me?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Crownslayer...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Ursus... us... Ursus.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The Empire just hasn't gotten to the point where they'll treat all the Ursus like we do.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Goodbye, all of you. Don't make the same mistakes I did.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Girl...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What's your name? And where are you going?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Call me 'Nine.'

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I'm going to where the fire burns the hottest.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I knew you'd be here.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Can't hide from you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You came here to mourn them.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I may be mourning us. Or reflecting on mortality and greed.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Your sword says something else.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: At least my sword isn't cutting your throat.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I know you don't mean it, Old Wei. If we were really going at it, who can say which one of us would drop first?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Be serious please.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have to give you a few good jabs, old friend. You know, Hui-chieh and those Infected got it done.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You should think things over again, the arbitrary way you go about them. You almost dragged Lungmen into a war and wrecked the whole place.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm not sure about that. Even if Lungmen were to choose a certain future, it may yet choke it out over some small thing. A chance occurrence.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The city didn't choose her. We should be proud that she chose the city.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: They're not mutually exclusive, Kojui. The city chose her too.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Even if it wasn't ready to accept who she is...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And you should tell that to her. It's time for me to go, Old Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Wait, Kojui!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Did the Shadow Guard lie to me?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: They're your Shadow Guard, how should I know?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I should've known you and Lin Yuhsia were working together.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Your Shadow Guard aren't the Imperial Guards they once were. They're human now.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Do you think they can stand to watch you make another mistake?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So that means... when I told them to handle the Infected, then you...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Shh. Heaven knows. Besides, when you knew we would—

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Head back soon. That sick old tiger has something for you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: —Hui-chieh?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh, you're here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Uncle Lin.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Look at you, dressed like this, it looks like you're headed right off somewhere.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Do remember to visit from time to time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm not sure I can.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Then you'll have to write us, let us know you're safe out there.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I will, Uncle Lin.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: This is where Talulah's father is buried... And your mother.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: In the end, they couldn't be buried in the city they loved. Or, in the case of your mother, it was a matter of both love and hate.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'll never forget the look of this place, Hui-chieh. I think of them whenever I see it... my sister, and my sworn brother, with whom I shared no blood.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: They are buried here.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: A place too small to house their passion, words too weak to express their remorse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: An unmarked grave.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Yes. Heh... names perhaps mean more to the living.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: All around the world, we idealize burial, as all graves eventually disappear. No one knows a peaceful, eternal sleep.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Catastrophe, war, abandonment, and all such things. Should a city disappear, the souls buried within disappear right along with it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And in the countless settlements that dot the land, I have never yet found one where the descendants knew the location of the graves of their ancestors.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There is a form of burial called the Tombway, it denotes a part of a nomadic city's pathing as the burial ground, where the dead will be tossed from the city, with the passing cycle as a form of honor.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm too forgetful. Too many things I forget too easily, too many things I want so desperately to forget.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But dare not ever forget them.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And so... I picked this place for them.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I brought my sister to Lungmen, I met Fumizuki in Lungmen, along with Edward, who had fled to Lungmen.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I can't say we made the best of friends, but he was smart, and bold.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Kashchey ruled Lungmen from the shadows, and saw us as thorns in his side. We knew we had no choice but to depose him... it was the only way to give us a future in the city.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Here, this grave, is the farthest Lungmen had ever been.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: After we beat Kashchey and exiled him from Lungmen, the city sat a few dozen miles away, bright, and full of hope. Our future awaited us.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We drank, talked, laughed, enjoyed ourselves without a thought to our remaining fuel.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We very nearly died of thirst until Adams, that sick old tiger, coughed up his car to come get us. Boy did he give Edward and I the business after that.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Oh... he wasn't as old then. Nor was he as sick, or ferocious.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But who cares? We were all having a good time.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lin was laughing... laughing like we didn't have blood on our hands... laughing like we were boys in the time of our lives.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Edward was the scion of the highest Londinium nobility. And we were keeping that secret in Lungmen. But Kashchey already knew, he may have long since started plotting.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: He told my jealous twin and the Shadow of Londinium about Edward and my sister... about their relationship...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I was forced to choose between Edward or my sister's unborn child.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I hid it for ten years after Edward died. Only my brother and Kashchey knew. But now, Edward and my sister are both gone from this world.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Someday, a Catastrophe will strike and wipe away everything. No one will remember the tragic lovers buried here. These two, who died because of me, will be forgotten.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I met 'Kashchey.' He may be more evil than either of us know.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I can imagine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This grave...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Mother.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It was my fault your mother wasn't so warm towards you. I had to have her marry that Yan noble, to protect her. I should have done better.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's all in the past.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Promise me, Wei Yenwu. Promise me you won't let Lungmen turn into a grave.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Never again.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: As if I could trust a word you say.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I never needed your trust. Hmph... But, you can believe me this one time. Like when I promised to train you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You trained me well. I couldn't have gotten her back without you.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm glad.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't think you've spoken to me in ten years as much as you did today.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I think we talked a lot?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What I mean is as Ch'en Hui-chieh. Not as Superintendent Ch'en.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll be off.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What are you planning to do with your sister?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I have no feelings for Talulah anymore. Except guilt.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Good. That's what you should feel.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We're one pair of the countless separated siblings in this world. Most will never be reunited.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Even so, I can't just let her go. I still don't know what she is, it's still not clear.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There's a prison to keep criminals, but Lungmen we know today can't hold her.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I can't make the Lungmen that could. Only you can create an L.G.D. that could keep the Infected and the uninfected together.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It doesn't have to be me. We all have our own part to play.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know that truth, no matter how correct it might be. If the people of Lungmen don't accept it, then they won't. I've seen too much of the slums.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And if it is possible to build something like that, I'd like to do it with Rhodes Island first.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talulah... no matter how long it takes, I will get her a fair trial.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You really have grown up.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't need to hear that from you, Sir. I don't think it's a good thing.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If I, on behalf of Lungmen, ask you to stay, will you do it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If you and Talulah ever wanted to come back, Lungmen would make the move to take you back, if it can.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There are so many things we can't do. But maybe them, in the future, maybe they could.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I just hope you haven't forgotten what you were reflecting on. That would be good enough.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Say hello to Aunt Fumizuki for me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Err...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Uncle...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Take care of yourself.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hui-chieh!
Ch'en stops for a moment, but she does not turn back.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The path before you is long and hard. But I know you will master it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll bear that in mind.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Right then. What's the second condition you wanted to offer Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: After using them to wipe out Reunion, I would ask them to take as many of Lungmen's Infected as they could.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Give them land, resources, funding, and all the materials they need.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: They can't refuse. Even if they know this is a hard pill to swallow.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I have done this before, and I will continue to do it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No hesitation, no regret.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: And for now?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: *Sigh*. The situation has changed. And we must change with it.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Is there a problem with you thanking them directly?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You don't worry so much about winning and losing as you used to. And I think I can guess the reason.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: It's about our little Ch'en.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: That's why things have changed?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lungmen's Infected belong in Lungmen.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: So what about Ch'en?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: She has her own path to walk.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Will you visit her?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: The Chief of Lungmen can't have anything to do with an Infected organization.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hmph. Harsh.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Then I'll go.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Well... say hello to her for me.
When forced to choose between my sister and my sworn brother, I chose my sister. I vowed to let no harm come to them, but...
I broke that vow.
This time is different. I will never choose again.
Kashchey was wrong. I had no choice. Wei Yenwu, you have only one path to walk, in fact.
Even if it is the path of fratricide.
For the sake of my two nieces, for the sake of the Lungmen in my dreams. Even if it is my one and only path.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: (Hui-chieh... live well.)
A few weeks later...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Attention, honored Rhodes Island operators, this is Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thanks to our efforts, the Chernobog issue has been resolved peacefully.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Does it hurt?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ow... Only if you poke it!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Oh. Sorry.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's fine... how are you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ehwhaaa? No way, little kitten... since when do you keep things to yourself?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Is that bad...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Oh, of course not! Scout, can you see? Our little kitten is all grown up! She's a big girl!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She's so big now... waaaahhhh...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: D-Don't cry... I want to forget!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're really crying? Why are you crying?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Waaaahhhh...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: D-Don't cry, Blaze... don't...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Bluishsilver should know... Ace too... our kitten... she's grown up...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Blaze...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Waaaaaaahhhhh!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Much of the truth will stay buried forever in the ruins of Chernobog.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because we live in an uncaring world.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Rhodes Island will remember. No matter what else we undertake... we must remember.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A Rhodes Operator does not sacrifice her life for a single person or event.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Oh, this topical medicine is really useful!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: There are lots of similar patents out there, but I think this cream is effective enough to have a market.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: The main point is that even if it's not especially effective, it is very cheap to produce... all the components that came up in analysis were common, wild-growing plants.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: It's a bit of a pain to get them from the northwest tundra, they're spread over such a wide area.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: The inventor must've had more perseverance than medical knowledge.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Where do you want to apply for the patent, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In Ursus. And make it cheap.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: But I think the Empire has similar tech?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ursus has more people who need it.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: What should we name it then?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll call it... FrostNova.

options: Amiya? Were you looking for me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, Dr. {@nickname}!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Medic, you and Warfarin take care of it.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: We'll take it from here!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I'm coming!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is not for the results that we commit to what we do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We do something not because we want to see it done.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As a business, this may be a foolish strategy. But we live for more than material gain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our brave operators have proved that life, and its value, lay not only in ensuring the survival of one or even many people, or in its biological definition...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have to live on in the moral, civilized sense. Because the future of life needs support, and Rhodes Island is that support.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We are fighting for a cause that will heal the scars on our world.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Another mission?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Yes. With Meteorite.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Care to bring a greenie? I have some new recruits who need to learn.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Oh? I don't think so. This is going to be a tough one.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Jessica and FrostLeaf are going out on patrol. They might be in a better place to take a recruit.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Jessica? Can she handle it?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: I think you've seen how far she's come.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I have. I think she'll certainly be able to put some pressure on the new recruits.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Then Nearl is going to crush me with all her pressure.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...I... am I really that heavy?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: No, that's not what I meant. *Sigh*.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is for this belief that we are willing to die.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Ace Squad, thirteen members. Ace, Bad Tom, Kerg, Hard Brick—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —WoodsPoon, Seventeen, Bronze Nose, Green Pea, Lunar Silver, Confidenty, Sandwash, Violet Flame, and Caries.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya Squad, thirteen members. Dim Needle, B-Softhand, ChiliJimme, KeenEar.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: AngerNeighing, Sunty, Marco Smith, Fade.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Divides, FrostNova, Antonio Lisa, Wildash, Hui, and Indigo Jade.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can't put FrostNova on the KIA list.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter what you say, she wasn't an official employee.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What of the consequences? What if our operators are outraged at you putting a Reunion operative on our casualty list? It's not something you should do.

options: She fought for the same goal.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is that all it takes?

options: Rhodes Island fights for the same idea.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll do it. You've done your duty.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope you'll stay as you are now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —And I'd like to apologize for that thing back there, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The question you asked me back by the sarcophagus. I can't give you an answer. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't want to hide the truth, but I really can't give you the answer you're looking for, unfortunately. Neither I nor PRTS have a good explanation. I hope you can forgive us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But someday, when the time is right, it will appear to you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When that day comes. When you finally know the truth. Will you be ready?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Another thing, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya has taken on a lot of burdens. I hope you could... avoid giving her more bad memories.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We should take more onto ourselves instead, those things which we can't even face ourselves. We can do it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As long as you're here. As long as you are like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Scout Squad. Thirteen members. Scout, Milim, Tipsy...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Slink, Mimi, Leafa, Slanna, Mary...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Thumbtack, Mudflower, Macron, Pter, Scorpion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis Squad, one member, Bluishsilver. Raidian Squad, one member, Liqusa.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Forty-one sacrifices in all, in the Chernobog Incident.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island will not forget. We will remember their names forever.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even should Rhodes Island cease to exist someday, all that they have done will leave its mark on our world.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You don't want to talk?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I get it. So much has happened.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, with you by my side, I feel... I feel happy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are some things we can't do by ourselves.

options: But it's not like we do them for their own sake.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island... we always press forward, no matter what the dark clouds bring.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And no matter how many terrible stories unfold across the world...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll always believe in the warmth in your heart.

options: What will you do if I'm actually bad?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Welcome home, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then I'll have to stop you myself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Welcome home, Doctor.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Did she say anything?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nope. Not a peep since you brought her in.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She's so calm. Even when, uh... Ch'en, was it? Even when Ch'en came to see her, she didn't say anything.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: So what are you going to do about it?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Me? Do I look like Ascalon...? And I don't think we have anything we need from her yet anyway.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: More information is gonna depend on where you use it, I guess. I really don't know how to handle a person like that.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What about those L.G.D. people?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What? It's not like it's your first time at Rhodes Island. What's there to be shy about?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I just got promoted. I don't want anyone thinking I'm working under the table with Rhodes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy, you're totally good with it, huh? You make it look like you're going shopping.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Who could stop me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sure enough. You got that rich girl brain.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmm...? Chief Wei's office. Who's... that?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...An angel with blue hair? Or a Sarkaz?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Woah! She's really hurt!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey! You can't just barge in... Chief Wei is in there.
Looks like you got company, Chief.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Anyone who could make their way in here is someone I can trust. Let's have you look after your own wounds first.
If you don't mind letting those two out there eavesdrop, then this little scratch is no big deal.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What are you doing here, Laterano Messenger?
I'm not here as an official Laterano Messenger...
(Although, the Church does actually have a message for you.)

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hoshiguma! Take Swire outside.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, roger that!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey! Why just me...?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Speak, Messenger.
...He said... (Laterano language).
'What did you have for breakfast? And what will you eat for dinner?'

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Odd. Why would he want to know what I think?
I think... You are the Chief, Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: They're not here in an official capacity. The blonde tiger and the green-haired Oni... I think they're probably here to meet an old friend or something?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But hey, if we carry on like this, we could have the Ursus Royal Guard taking a stroll around the landship.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: When they came by, did the... patient, react at all?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I can only ever guess at what Kal'tsit's thinking. Oh, I'll get the surveillance set up, you stand under that camera. C'mon, c'mon~

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Humans are weak, complicated, selfish creatures.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Even cystybeasts possess a nobility human beings lack. They forage the land day after day, never stopping, never giving up.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Unlike humans.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Humans kill one another for food. Humans harm one another for selfish desires.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: As such, human beings use others to determine their own value, to measure their worth. You have what it takes to enlighten them them, you have the right to use them.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You know what you must do. I taught you all that you are... How do you overcome these countless years of oppressive history? The history of humanity is a history of struggle.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Wisdom, ideals, and methods... Your sight is my sight. Surrender your fantasies. Sooner or later, you will return to me.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I am your only end.
Kashchey... No, Kashchey. Absolutely not.
All that you taught me now weighs on my body, carved into it as scars forever. The past is behind us.
It's all... over.
Indeed... I must put an end to all you have brought.
All the ugliness and shame you cast upon me... will be my fuel. It will fuel my future.
Until I find you, until this world is liberated, I will never stop burning.
I will not deny you again, Kashchey. I oppose you.
Until all the wrongs have been righted and all our sins purged.
It will be done. Even if our end is the same, I will burn it all to ashes. Even if I burn to death.
How long have you been out?
Oh, I can't be bothered to count. I lost track a while ago.
But even if you run, you won't get away.
One needs a hammer to strike a nail. And if all you have is a hammer, everything looks like a nail.
Maybe now is the time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Vina! Come here, please. I have words for you.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Alright, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Just a moment. One question. Are you ready?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm not sure. But I guess I'm ready whenever.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Your Majesty...

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Here is the completed report on the incident.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: —How did this happen?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Did one of the Royal Guards betray us?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Witte, give me an honest answer.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: My chest is an unlit fireplace on a winter day. Only honest words will get my heart beating again, whether or not an unpleasant truth may break it.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: No. Your Royal Guards would never betray Your Majesty. They will remain loyal to you until the world itself is consumed by fire, as long as you are the rightful Emperor of Ursus.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: You and I both know those are but empty words. Would that the Guard did more than stand back and watch the old monster die...

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Enough! No more platitudes, no more masks, I've grown weary! Witte, you are no fool. Tell me your thoughts! And look me in the eye as you do!

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Where are the puppetmasters behind this plot?

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Grand Duke Baikal, Deputy Marshal of the Third Army and Governor General Rosin, and Viscount Kerque.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Of course, I still lack the evidence to prove that they actually orchestrated the entire ordeal.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Further, when the Royal Guard went to hang them all in their homes. They found...

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: These traitors, lacking the courage to face their crimes and your wrath, they took their own lives rather than bear their due punishment.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Cowards... absolute cowards! Have they not even the meager courage it takes to stand trial?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: They must have known! They knew that a trial would reveal their base desires, their corrupted minds, to all the people of Ursus!

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: And yet... now we will never bring them to trial.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: True, Your Majesty. How regrettable that we must now keep this knowledge behind the curtain, rather than take it out onto the stage.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Even a stupid burdenbeast will do more than chew grass when roused.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Nevertheless, the Royal Guard disposed of their remains in the proper manner.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Their rotten corpses will dangle, stinking from the ceiling. No one will dare take them down.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Had their conspiracy succeeded, Ursus would have suffered another war, they would have seen their influence increase, proportionally draining the power of the Council... perhaps further degrading our cities.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: We are most fortunate they failed.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Traitors! Death was too good for them. I should feed them to the Flesh Buthidas!

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: But... that would be a terrible thing. No. We can't do that.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Pardon me, Witte. I didn't mean to lash out like that.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: We must not go back down the road of ruin. No matter how much rage I have for my enemies, I cannot exhibit such behavior.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: You did not resort to them during the Great Rebellion. To this day, I feel that only a proper, blood-soaked threat would have stirred them.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Pure terror is the only language those who terrorize the innocent can understand.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Although I am personally opposed to such measures.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Unfathomable.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Must I resort to such ancient brutality, such poisonous traditions to stand against the ignorant?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: And as these maggots seize the swords and shields of our empire, are even we left to naught but rot?

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Forgive me, Your Majesty. I do not have an answer to that question. From a constitutional perspective, I am not your legal spymaster.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: More importantly, Witte, is the legend true? Is the 'Deathless Black Snake' a malignant deity that cannot be slain?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: And are there other such deities like it in our realm? What can we do to free our people from this tyranny?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Witte, we stand now in the light... surrounded by darkness! Can we use fire to illuminate Ursus?

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Your Majesty, I must point to one fact. In recent decades, only the Duke of Kashchey, among all the Ageless, shows clear signs of involvement in these events.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: And even after his death, we are unable to confirm her identity.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: That tells us that the Ageless of Ursus... still fear you.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: They fear you and your contempt.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Nearly a thousand years have passed since we overthrew the Hippogryph. A couple of dying monsters cannot stand against the might of the Ursus people.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Let them do as they will. They will fail.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: We will find them, and we will destroy them. Your Majesty need not worry.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I hope it all proceeds as you've said.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: What of the Infected situation? Any developments?

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Your Majesty is overhasty. You acted too quickly to close the Infected mines the armies held in the northwest.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: It may have been your hope to weaken the Army's supply reserves, or even show a little benevolence—

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: But as much as the Army opposes you, your people also oppose this. They fear the Infected.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: It is unwise to go against your people, at this juncture. They by and large despise the Infected, and standing against the Army here could be seen as you standing against the people.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: You lack the resources to pursue this course.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Even if it's the right thing to do?

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Even if it's the right thing to do. This is to show leniency to the Infected by shoveling them into the jaws of hell.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: It is time, Your Majesty. Yurodstvo has been waiting at the door for over fifteen minutes. I think you may want to see to him.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Hmph. Raving lunatic with his holy visions! I'll make a proper joke of him.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: But before that, Witte, do you think we can do it? Can we make Ursus great again?

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: I don't know, Your Majesty. Now is not an appropriate time to answer you.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: But at least you do not lay waste to the world as your father did. That is already quite good.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Talulah the Infected... hm.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: Should you break the curse of the Deathless Black Snake, then you should be able to break through everything that weighs upon you.

steps.name: Islam Witte
steps.text: I hope that one day we have a real chance to defeat the country of the last emperor.
Talulah?
You're doing a good service, standing guard in this weather.
I know it is what you want.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So you do. Until we walk out of this winter, my fire will keep burning.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (Sh. Quiet...)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (They're sleeping.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Oh, sorry. Shh.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (They trained all day?)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (The kid with the dark hair looks like he could handle a bow.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (But he'll need to grow a bit.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Then let them sleep. But...)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (I'm about to leave. I'm dropping the temperature too much. They'll catch a cold.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Sorry to bother you.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (You didn't. It's just the one with the white hair... he's a light sleeper. If I don't sing to him, he has night terrors. I don't know what he's been through.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Time heals all wounds.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Is your father still working on tomorrow's battle plan? He told me something about an Ursus Infected transport center.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (He has to think carefully, keep our losses low. He always tells me to pay attention to that.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (It's already so late.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (I've never seen him sleep. Not once.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Heroes need rest too. The other fighters should've taken some.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (Think of yourself before him. Who was that you reached out to a few days ago? Where were they from?)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Lyudmila and Alex. Looks like they've been around Chernobog. They know the city well.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (That's a big city.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Yes. And with lots of Infected in it. We might be able to bring them in... with the right plan.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Lyudmila and the people with her seem strong. I think they might become dependable allies, even if they're a little ornery right now.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (Ornery as those of us fighting the Ursus Army all the time?)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (Chernobog. It's too far, and too many things stand in our way. How many years would it take? Three or four still wouldn't get us there.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Even if we don't fight it or stop it... it will have to come to us. With the efforts of the Infected in the city, we can build a city of our own.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (And maybe, in three or four years' time... we'll be looking at tomorrow. Tomorrow is so close.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (I like the sound of that.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (Get some rest.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Right. Good night.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Good night, Sasha, and Eno.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: (Hurry back. I'll send the kids to the settlement soon.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Right.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (My brothers and sisters...)
Good night.
